choose.when: ORDER BY c.release_year DESC NULLS LAST, cc.display_order ASC, cc.content_id ASC, cc.credit_id ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY cc.content_id ASC, CASE cc.role WHEN 'DIRECTOR' THEN 1 WHEN 'ACTOR' THEN 2 WHEN 'WRITER' THEN 3 WHEN 'PRODUCER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, cc.display_order ASC, cc.credit_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT cc.credit_id, cc.content_id, cc.person_id, cc.role, cc."CHARACTER" AS character, cc.display_order, p.name_ko, p.name_org, p.profile_image_url, c.title_ko, c.poster_url, TO_CHAR(c.release_year, 'YYYY-MM-DD') release_year FROM content_credit cc JOIN person p ON cc.person_id = p.person_id JOIN content c ON cc.content_id = c.content_id WHERE cc.credit_id = #{creditId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CONTENT_CREDIT.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO content_credit ( credit_id, content_id, person_id, role, "CHARACTER", display_order ) VALUES ( #{creditId}, #{contentId}, #{personId}, #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{character, jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{displayOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.update: UPDATE content_credit SET content_id = #{contentId}, person_id = #{personId}, role = #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, "CHARACTER" = #{character, jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, display_order = #{displayOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE credit_id = #{creditId}
